2608.30996.title: Faithfulness Is Not Free: Auditing Offline KV-Cache Quantization in Retrieval-Augmented Generation
2608.30996.paper_summary: Retrieval-augmented generation systems can precompute and store key-value caches of retrieved documents to avoid re-encoding context at every query. Quantizing these caches further reduces storage, but no prior work asks whether compression damages faithfulness, whether responses remain grounded in the retrieved evidence. Faithfulness and accuracy are not equivalent: a model can produce a correct answer that is no longer supported by the context it was given. We evaluate Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct under INT8 and INT4 quantization on RGB and HotpotQA, measuring both accuracy and faithfulness with a hallucination detector, NLI entailment, and an LLM judge. INT8 is near-lossless across both metrics. INT4 reduces accuracy and, more critically, even among answers that remain factually correct, over 90% of faithfulness changes are negative, i.e., accuracy metrics are blind to this regression. The harm grows under noisy retrieval and with more retrieved chunks. Faithfulness must be audited before compressed caches are deployed.
2608.30996.paper_summary_zh: 檢索增強生成系統可以預先計算並儲存檢索文件的鍵值快取，以避免在每次查詢時重新編碼上下文。量化這些快取進一步減少存儲，但之前的研究並未探討壓縮是否會損害真實性，以及回應是否仍然基於檢索到的證據。真實性和準確性並不等同：一個模型可以產生一個正確的答案，但該答案不再受到其所給予的上下文的支持。我們在 RGB 和 HotpotQA 上評估 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct 在 INT8 和 INT4 量化下的表現，使用幻覺檢測器、NLI 蕴涵和 LLM 評判來測量準確性和真實性。INT8 在這兩個指標上幾乎無損。INT4 降低了準確性，更關鍵的是，即使在事實上仍然正確的答案中，超過 90% 的真實性變化都是負面的，即準確性指標對這種退化是盲目的。在嘈雜的檢索和更多檢索片段的情況下，損害會加劇。在部署壓縮快取之前，必須對真實性進行審核。
